content:
maya: quick follow-up re: rollout metadata. we saw tenant overrides getting stomped by global short leases in a-prod. need a clear, server-side merge rule.
alex: agreed. current effective-lease = min(all_leases) is too blunt. tenants expect their explicit scope to win.
rui: proposal: server computes final resolved_ttl using lease_preference order: TENANT > WORKSPACE > ORG > GLOBAL unless an explicit lease_priority field exists. default behavior = SCOPE_PRIORITY.
dan: also propose entropy as a 0-1 float (entropy_score). use it only as an advisory weight on resolved_ttl: resolved = base_lease_hours * (1 - entropy_score * 0.4). server tunable factor.
maya: good. keep client simple: always read resolved_ttl; if missing, fallback to lease_hours*(1-entropy_score).
schema-bot: note: adding fields requires a compat-safe rollout. add migration: (1) add optional fields, (2) background resolver pass writes resolved_ttl + reason, (3) dry-run then write.
alex: add telemetry: pin_resolution_reason and resolved_ttl_histogram. small example in RFC doc: ```json {"model_id":"gpt-lite","pin":{"lease_hours":24,"entropy_score":0.3,"lease_priority":"SCOPE_PRIORITY","resolved_ttl":1760000000}} ```
rui: let's land schema PR with migration plan by Friday. tagging @dan @alex to own docs and migration. :thumbsup:
